woman_before.say: Signal's terrible today. My radio keeps announcing the weather for a town I've never heard of.

woman_after.say: My radio just said my name. I unplugged it. It said it again.
I don't remember plugging it back in.

oldtimer_before.say: Vale hasn't left that workshop in weeks. Used to be a hell of a Debugger. Before the... well. Before.

oldtimer_after.say: Did the power come back on? It never really went off. It just... stopped being sure.

angler_before.say: Caught nothing. Again. But I caught the same nothing three times, which is progress.

angler_after.say: The canal's reflection is a second behind now. When I wave, the fish waves back late.

farmer_a_before.say: My crops grow so fast lately. Too fast. Yesterday's weeds are today's hedge.

farmer_a_after.say: The Node's fixed! The sprouts stopped blinking. I miss it, a bit.

farmer_b_before.say: The irrigation channel runs backwards on Tuesdays. It's Thursday.

farmer_b_after.say: Clean State told me my crops are 'within tolerance'. They said it as if I should be grateful.

granny_before.say: The Hub's vending machine gives free drinks when it's raining. Don't tell the Hub.

granny_after.say: The new people in white coats keep correcting my knitting. 'There's a deviation in row nine', they say.

hallow_before.say: I've been counting my crops for six months. It's never come out the same. I think the number is having a bad time.

hallow_after.say: Everything's quieter. Cleaner. I'd call it a relief, but my wife says I'm lying.

then.say: Have we met? ...Yes. I remember. Thank you. I'm on Route 01 and here and in Bellwether and nowhere. It's very peaceful.

else.say: No... no, that was Route 01. Wasn't it? Odd. I feel like I'm in two places at once.
